{"new_text":"def _iter_module_level_nodes(node: ast.AST):
    """Yield module-scope bindings inside one statement without entering local scopes.

    Function, async-function, and class bodies own local namespaces even when
    they are declared inside module control flow, so their stores, imports, and
    names are never module-level bindings.
    """
    pending = [node]
    while pending:
        current = pending.pop()
        if isinstance(current, ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef | ast.ClassDef):
            continue
        yield current
        pending.extend(reversed(tuple(ast.iter_child_nodes(current))))
